conditional_findings.first_failed_contract_or_question: Current view names and camera subjects are joined only by a shared ordinal between independently authored constant arrays; neither array carries the typed association.
trace: The parent defines45 CATALOG slug/label pairs and generates each CaptureViewSpec with CityExterior camera equal to that index. The catalog setup separately iterates FurnitureKind::INTERIOR, stages each kind and pushes its camera in that order. The viewer retains those catalog cameras, resolves the selected pose by camera index and names its capture and PNG with the view slug.

The current static comparison normalizes each kind name to kebab-case and matches all45 slugs, and compares five finish slugs to FinishableFurnitureKind::ALL. Current FurnitureVariant::ALL is Compact then Broad and FurnitureWoodState::ALL is Natural, Handled, Repaired, Painted. These are source-name checks, not proof of images or every human label.

A hypothetical source edit swapping only DiningTable and Bench in FurnitureKind::INTERIOR would preserve array lengths while the first view remains dining-table and index0 camera is staged for Bench. The inspected source tests check slug uniqueness, camera indices, framing and count but do not assert kind-to-slug association. This is a counterfactual source change, not an existing current mismatch or an executed test.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The current declared order matches all compared slugs. Labels may be intentional editorial names, and future developers may already coordinate changes; no actual erroneous image, supported source change or runtime execution is asserted. Finish rows have a similar positional relationship but any exact alias and scope require further review; room rows use a different selection owner.
conditional_findings.prior_attribution: Segovb549–550 explicitly recorded the parallel association and left the canonical kind order and actual consumers pending at6533; this later95e trace and static comparison change no historical count.
connected_repair_dependencies: After full audit and separate implementation authorization, make a single typed row own each kind, slug and label or otherwise enforce the exact association at construction, and derive staging and view selection from it.
Preserve intended variant/finish order, supported exhibition behavior, selected view names and independent room/finish semantics; reconcile exact aliases.
later_acceptance: Changing a typed catalog kind cannot silently make a view slug or camera refer to another subject; the current45 rows and five finish rows retain intended subject associations.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; current order and consumer chain inspected, future reorder counterfactual only; complete label semantics, finishes, room rows and aliases remain open
